s4Advisory: Advisory only. You can always continue; no case will be merged or rejected.
s4Unavailable: Matching is unavailable or policy is not configured. You may continue.
s4ChoiceUnavailable: Choice could not be recorded. You may continue; retry recording when available.
s4Demo: Configured matching rules; a human reviews every suggestion.
s4Subject: Subject (used locally; not stored as text)
s4Proceeded: Proceed choice recorded; case status and ownership are unchanged.
s4Polling: Refreshes every 15 seconds; polling, no sockets.
s4NotEligible: Eligibility unavailable or not eligible. No case details disclosed.
s4_ADVISORY_ONLY: A human decides; this is advisory
s4_REPEATED_DOCUMENT_REQUEST: A document request may be repeated
s4_OVERLAPPING_BUREAU_ACTION: Another bureau has a similar action
s4_NO_NAMED_CONFLICT_FOUND: No named conflict found in the fresh action feed
s4_HUMAN_DECIDES: The officer decides whether to proceed
s4_documentOrSubject:NO_SUPPORTING_EVIDE: Document or subject: No supporting evidence
s4_documentOrSubject:PERIOD_NOT_AVAILABL: Document or subject: Period evidence unavailable
s4_semantic:NO_SUPPORTING_EVIDENCE: Local character n-gram similarity: No supporting evidence
s4_semantic:PERIOD_NOT_AVAILABLE: Local character n-gram similarity: Period evidence unavailable
